sample_policy: Maximum across three original runs; observed min–max shown. Existing targeted measurements retain this same maximum statistic.

faithful_methodology.correctnessFix: tools/prepare-rich-components.mjs creates build/faithful before writing fingerprint
faithful_methodology.memoryStatistic: GNU time -v maximum RSS, KiB; not sum of concurrent process RSS
faithful_methodology.execution: Serial builds, no overlapping benchmark workloads; dependency installation excluded

cacheClasses.warm-full: All prepared docs, code, web, metadata and Nift output caches present; nift build --all
cacheClasses.no-op: Same caches and unchanged authored sources; nift build
cacheClasses.web-regeneration: Delete build/faithful/web-fingerprints.json only; code/docs and metadata caches retained; nift build --all
cacheClasses.cold-intermediates: Remove build/faithful, .nift/mdx-prepared and .nift/mdx-cache; retain installed dependencies, public assets and Nift output state; nift build --all
cacheClasses.clean-checkout: Separately measured from fresh clone with no copied caches; tools/build.mjs --all initializes assets; installation excluded
cacheClasses.incremental: Edit actual authored docs/rich MDX text, marketing title or blog text; nift build; restore source then rebuild unmeasured after each class
cacheClasses.upstream-astro: bun run build explicitly clears per-app output/Astro/deploy caches every run; dependencies and committed data/script snapshots retained; recorded fetch preload for plans/credits/rankings. Other optional external requests preserve upstream behavior.

faithful_methodology.failedPreFixRun: Preserved in pre-fix; excluded from successful benchmark medians
faithful_methodology.priming: Final Nift suite runs an unmeasured full build before warm samples. The earlier partial-cache recovery sample is retained only in before-inline-space-fix.
faithful_methodology.finalNiftSuite: Post inline-spacing fix; all classes repeated. Earlier data retained under before-inline-space-fix and pre-fix.

agent_methodology.niftSourceRevisionReason: Installed executable does not expose its source commit; binary hash is the exact identity.
